changes.summary: Pressed and open menu-bar headings keep their size and are drawn as a flat navy highlight with white text and an unmoved label, not sunken (GUI95's reading of the Windows 95 menu bar, not a cited source); menu items no longer sink when pressed; check and option marks and the submenu arrow are pixel artwork in the item colour (marks embossed when unavailable) with no generated text, so the marks stay out of the accessible name and do not depend on a symbol font.
